title: Category Theory by Tom LaGatta
summary: Tom LaGatta's talk on category theory at a 2014 LispNYC meetup, covering objects, morphisms and the basic ideas in an informal, conversational style. It runs about 97 minutes.
why: Recommended as a more approachable introduction to category theory than the more formal lecture series people often start with.

quote.text: Milewski's YouTube lectures gets mentioned a lot, but I couldn't make much sense of them before watching Tom LaGatta's more informal and conversational presentation
